raised: A dark box headed 'מס רק במכירה' stays open on every screen and covers parts of the page, hiding numbers such as the yearly-return/% input box and parts of the hedging tables
Worry that Ylin Lapidot has only one year of history; its 0% fee could be a launch offer, and the page doesn't say whether it can go up
The cost breakdown bar has too many colours
The coloured tags in the fund list were confusing
The Psagot pricing note about monthly purchases counted as a standing order was hard to follow even after two readings
The foreign funds (no price, estate tax, W-8BEN form) aren't relevant; the reader would cut them first
The year-by-year hedging table was too much and partly hidden
The '+0.37%' figures were unclear (a return or something else?), and the explanation sat at the bottom, half under the popup
Didn't understand what '4D' and '4A' mean
Didn't understand the difference between a tracker fund and an ETF, or why ETFs cost more
Didn't understand 'מס גם על שינוי המטבע' (whether tax is due on a profit that came only from the dollar)
Didn't understand 'עמלות זו על זו' in the colour legend
Didn't understand why the popup about foreign funds ('an open question… shown without a ranking') stayed open over everything
Didn't understand 'עוד לא נאסף' (not collected by whom?)
Couldn't find exactly how the final tax is calculated (25% on profit only? anything for age?)
Wanted a ready-made answer for a 5-year horizon
Couldn't find how safe the money is if the broker or fund manager gets into trouble
Couldn't find how to start (opening an account, standing order, whether this fund allows one)
Couldn't find what separates the top two funds beyond the 43 ₪ (size, age, stability)
Would drop the coloured line chart under 'what matters most'
Would drop the dollar chart since 2002
Would drop the list of advert claims for each broker
Would drop the 'not in the calculation' discounts for young people, soldiers and students

problems.why: The reader complains that the 'מס רק במכירה' box covers the page and asks why it stays open, but never says the label claims something the site doesn't know, even though they quote the box's own 'open question' text.
